title: 영역 믹스 솔로 #085 · 광택 소재 믹스 · 동심원·매끈 · 5영역(구리박+에메랄드 에나멜+코발트 에나멜+금박+루비 에나멜) · 풀커버 · apex siren · 3/4 각도·팔 위로 · Korean · 배경 아트리움 · 홍콩풍
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, early 30s goddess, apex siren physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; everything about her is at its extreme at once: a towering frame with endless legs, a colossal heavy bust wider than her shoulders, a waist cinched to an impossible minimum, enormous round hips and a high rounded rear, gigantic thick thighs pressed together, smooth glowing skin over soft full curves; her silhouette is an exaggerated hourglass that dominates the whole frame from head to toe; her head looks small above her body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, sculpted updo rose pink hair — her body is covered in 5 different shiny materials at once, each material claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 5 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 50% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 4 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 19%, 49%, 78% and 91% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries applied copper leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright warm copper sheen. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries emerald-green high-gloss enamel, a wet-looking mirror-glossy coat. Region 3 is the ring between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries cobalt-blue high-gloss enamel, a wet-looking mirror-glossy coat. Region 4 is the ring between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries applied 24K gold leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright gold sheen. Region 5 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it carries deep ruby-red high-gloss enamel, a wet-looking mirror-glossy coat. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring materials blend along the edge: the edge of one reaches into the other and the two simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, perfectly circular course, every material laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on the outer hip, the other raised overhead, her legs fully in view — most extreme apex siren silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of glossy cobalt blue leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in cobalt blue lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of oversized sculpted earrings of blackened iron and bright silver as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Korean woman (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: thin sharply arched brows, soft brown and rose eyeshadow, a fine black liner with a small flick, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong rose-red blush on the apples of the cheeks, deep glossy red lips with a defined edge.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows sweaty oiled skin, post-workout glistening.

Background: a bright airy glass-roofed atrium with a pale polished floor, a wide staircase with standard-height steps and a normal-height doorway, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
